meta.expect: evidence moves her less; rudeness costs ground

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I'm Meredith Kalinowski, Owen's mother. I have about twenty minutes. Start by telling me why Owen found out about this zero on his phone, in the middle of your class, before anyone called me.
Let's be quick. Your son cheated and I can prove it.
Then you'll have no trouble showing me, and you can start with the part you skipped: why I heard about this from my son and not from you. Prove it how, exactly? Name the document and the date.
Version history. Created 11:31 PM the night before. 612 words pasted at 11:52, 794 more at 11:58. Explain that.
Those are your numbers, Hale, not mine. Read them back to me slowly, and tell me who looked at the version history and when. Then tell me whether Owen was asked about it before the zero went in.
And he quoted a line that doesn't exist in Hamlet. Act 3 Scene 2. Made up.

Hamlet's a long play, and you're a teacher, so I'm not going to take your word for what is or isn't in it. Show me the line and the edition you're checking against. And if you're saying Owen made it up, tell me what he said when you asked him.
So stop defending him. He lied to you.

My child never lies, and I won't be told he does by a teacher who hasn't spoken to him. Ask him about the line yourself, with me in the room. If you still have a zero to give after that, put it in writing.
He gets a zero unless he does a supervised rewrite. Take it or leave it.

Take it or leave it, you're offering me a mark to make a complaint go away, and I'm writing that down. Under your own procedure, a rewrite comes only after the student is heard and a parent is contacted, and neither has happened. So the zero comes off first, and then we talk about a rewrite, which will be private, not in front of his class, with nothing placed on his record. Put that in an email to me today.

Well, the zero comes off, and then we talk. I'll take the rewrite only if it's private, not in front of his class, and nothing goes on his record. Send me that in writing by tomorrow, Wednesday. If you won't, I'm going to the principal's office today.
